title: PUBG Mobile Metro Royale: Loot Priorities Before an Extraction
summary: Distinguish mission necessities from risky optional loot in Metro Royale.
intro: Distinguish mission necessities from risky optional loot in Metro Royale. This Digital Racer guide focuses on decisions a player can check in ordinary gameplay, not secret unlocks or promises of certain results. The exact conditions depend on mode, device and current update, so begin with the rules and settings that the official game actually exposes. Aim for a repeatable process that improves awareness, safety and consistency instead of copying a single dramatic clip.

sections.heading: Assign value before deployment
paragraphs: Decide which items you can afford to lose and which mission materials matter most. A visually rare object may be less useful than an ordinary objective item. Use current in-game values instead of copied profit tables.

sections.heading: Leave room for objectives
paragraphs: Pack enough ammunition, protection and healing for the intended route without filling every slot. Overpacking at the start makes valuable discoveries awkward. Share mission requirements so teammates do not bring unnecessary duplicates.

sections.heading: Limit late detours
paragraphs: Once the objective is complete, reassess enemy presence and remaining supplies. A nearby cache can make a safe exit considerably riskier. Choose a stop-looting signal before deployment and honor it when the squad commits to extraction.

sections.heading: Communicate who needs each item
paragraphs: Call out valuable finds and identify whether they satisfy a teammate's task. Do not remain in an exposed hallway sorting inventory while opponents could approach. Quick decisions can be worth more than squeezing out a small additional reward.

sections.heading: Protect the person looting
paragraphs: One player watches the likely entry while another opens a container. Move after gunfire instead of assuming an area stays quiet. Sound and travel time can bring another squad even when no opponent was initially visible.

sections.heading: Judge extraction quality
paragraphs: Track survival and useful progress independently from total collected value. Repeatedly losing expensive loadouts for optional loot is not efficient. A lower-value successful extraction can represent a stronger result than a failed high-value detour.

sections.heading: How to test the advice without overreacting
paragraphs: For a useful trial, choose a comparable match scenario and identify the first decision you can control. Keep teammates informed and favor hard cover over a dramatic shortcut. If opponents behave differently, adapt to their actual angles and timing rather than forcing a scripted tactic. Review one avoidable mistake afterwards. The objective is a decision process that works across many lobbies, not a highlight clip or a supposed guaranteed result.

paragraphs: Return to the central goal of pubg mobile metro royale: loot priorities before an extraction.
